jobs.title: VP Enterprise Marketing
jobs.description:
Mentimeter is an engagement tool with a clear goal in mind. To make every leader better. Through real-time interactivity and clear visualizations, we get people to participate, engage and become more productive. Transforming all those passive meetings, airless classrooms and drawn out trainings into valuable insights and impactful moments.

We truly believe that you achieve the best results by doing things together. And that successful leaders need to adopt a curious and collaborative mindset in order to get there. So with you at Mentimeter, you’ll be a big part of the ambition to help over 1 billion people listen, learn and work better together.

### **Build Mentimeter's enterprise growth engine**

  

40 million users have experienced the value of using a Menti!  
  
Building on that product-led foundation, Mentimeter is used daily by more than 84.000 organisations globally across all industries and we now serve more than 3,200 Enterprise customers globally. Our next challenge is to increase a systematic enterprise demand growth engine - and we are looking for a VP Enterprise Marketing to lead that journey.

This is a global leadership role responsible for how Mentimeter creates, identifies and converts enterprise demand. You will lead our Enterprise Marketing organisation, report to our Chief Sales Officer and join Mentimeter's Global Enterprise Leadership Team. Your primary focus will be EMEA and North America, while building the foundations for APAC. The goal is to connect our product adoption, organic reach and customer base into an Enterprise qualified pipeline, ARR and customer growth.

### **What you'll lead**

  

You will lead three existing teams, each with an experienced leader, across three connected areas:  
  
**Digital demand**  
Build and optimize enterprise demand generation and capture across web, paid media, account-based programs, content distribution, conversion and nurture.  
  
**Field and customer marketing**  
Develop a global strategy across events, partner programs, customer advocacy, regional activation and use-case storytelling - measured by account engagement, adoption, pipeline and expansion, not simply attendance.  
  
**Executive Exchange**  
Build Mentimeter's Executive Exchange into a distinctive platform for strategic customers, including our Enterprise Community, executive networks, education and certification programs.

  

### **What you'll own**

* Define and own Mentimeter's global Enterprise Marketing strategy, budget and operating model.
* Build an integrated system for demand generation and demand capture that turns our PLG footprint and product signals into account-level pipeline.
* Set priorities across segments, accounts, audiences, buying groups, use cases and regions, balancing global consistency with local relevance.
* Create qualified pipeline and measurable Enterprise ARR impact, with clear accountability for conversion, velocity, attribution and ROI.
* Recruit, coach and develop leaders and senior marketing talent, creating an organisation that performs beyond your direct involvement.
* Partner closely with Sales, Customer Success, Product, Growth, Brand, Data and regional leadership to strengthen the handover from product-led growth to sales-assisted opportunities.
* Stop, redesign or reallocate investment away from programs that do not create meaningful customer or commercial impact.

### **What will help you succeed**

  

You are an experienced B2B marketing leader who combines strategic range with commercial discipline. You are likely to bring:

* 12+ years of B2B SaaS marketing experience, including significant leadership experience in Enterprise Marketing, Demand Generation, Integrated Marketing or a closely related area.
* Experience leading leaders and multidisciplinary teams across digital demand, field marketing, customer marketing or executive programs.
* A strong understanding of enterprise buying journeys, account-based marketing, buying groups, demand capture and pipeline creation in a PLG environment.
* Experience connecting product-led or high-volume inbound growth with a sales-assisted enterprise motion.
* Commercial fluency across funnel economics, pipeline, conversion, attribution, investment and ROI.
* Experience operating across EMEA and/or North America and adapting global programs to local markets.
* An AI-native approach to marketing: using AI to improve insight, experimentation, personalisation and performance - not only individual productivity.

### **The kind of leader who will thrive here**

You create clarity where ownership is shared and the answer is not obvious. You set a high bar while building trust, develop leaders and give talented people meaningful ownership. Most importantly, you want to build - not simply inherit and administer - a modern Enterprise Marketing function, see the strategy through and be accountable for its long-term impact. You are ambitious while staying humble, curious and collaborative in how you get there.

### **Why this role**

  

You will have the mandate to shape how Mentimeter approaches enterprise demand globally and define the next chapter of our Enterprise growth. If you are looking for a finished playbook, this probably is not the role for you. If you want to build the system and be accountable for its impact, we would like to hear from you.

We’re actively hiring for one position, which can be based in either Stockholm or Toronto. The role follows our hybrid way of working.

### **How we lead at Mentimeter**

At Mentimeter, we have a Leadership Manifesto that sets a shared direction for how we lead ourselves, our teams and the business. We call it Heart & Bravery.  
  
It starts with authenticity: knowing yourself, showing yourself and leading yourself.

jobs.title: Director, Data Management & AI Readiness - Deloitte Global Technology
jobs.description:
**Job Type:** DTTL - Secondment  
**Work Model:** Remote  
**Reference code:** 135337  
**Primary Location:** Toronto, ON  
**All Available Locations:** Toronto, ON; Halifax, NS; Ottawa, ON

  

**Our Purpose**

  

At Deloitte, our Purpose is to make an impact that matters. We exist to inspire and help our people, organizations, communities, and countries to thrive by building a better future. Our work underpins a prosperous society where people can find meaning and opportunity. It builds consumer and business confidence, empowers organizations to find imaginative ways of deploying capital, enables fair, trusted, and functioning social and economic institutions, and allows our friends, families, and communities to enjoy the quality of life that comes with a sustainable future. And as the largest 100% Canadian-owned and operated professional services firm in our country, we are proud to work alongside our clients to make a positive impact for all Canadians.

  

By living our Purpose, we will make an impact that matters.

* Have many careers in one Firm.
* Enjoy flexible, proactive, and practical benefits that foster a culture of well-being and connectedness.
* Learn from deep subject matter experts through mentoring and on the job coaching

Deloitte Global is the engine of the Deloitte network. Our professionals reach across disciplines and borders to develop and lead global initiatives. We deliver strategic programs and services that unite our organization.

**What will your typical day look like?**
-----------------------------------------

**Work you'll do**

  

Deloitte Global is the engine of the Deloitte network. Our professionals reach across disciplines and borders to develop and lead global initiatives. We deliver strategic programs and services that unite our organization.

The Director, Data Management & AI Readiness is responsible for defining and leading the strategy, operating model, and delivery of enterprise data management capabilities.

The role is the business owner for cross-domain data management capabilities that serve the Deloitte network, including Master Data Management (MDM), Metadata Management, Data Quality, Taxonomy Management, Reference Data, and Data Modeling.

Working across global applications, business functions, architecture teams, product organizations, and operational teams, the Director will establish scalable data management capabilities, drive adoption of enterprise standards and procedures, and develop trusted data assets for business operations, analytics, AI, regulatory compliance, and decision-making.

  

This leader serves as a key connector between business executives, application owners, enterprise architects, operations leaders, and technology teams, aligning diverse stakeholder perspectives and driving consensus on complex data management decisions across a global organization. This role is expected to establish measurable outcomes, monitor performance, and continuously evolve enterprise data management capabilities to an aligned target state and maturity model that the role will also define and govern.

The DSGO is responsible for building an integrated strategy and operating model to manage global data and AI products across their lifecycle, enabling better business outcomes, innovation, and client service.

  

**Key responsibilities**

  

1. Strategy & Leadership

* Define and execute the data management strategy for:
  + Master Data Management
  + Metadata Management
  + Ontology and Context Management
  + Data Quality
  + Taxonomy and Reference Data
  + Enterprise Data Models
* Develop multi-year roadmaps that align to business priorities, digital transformation objectives, and AI enablement goals.
* Establish and evolve enterprise operating models, governance forums, stewardship structures, and accountability frameworks.
* Champion the importance of trusted, governed data as a strategic enterprise asset.
* Lead a global team of data management professionals and subject matter experts.
  

2. Data Management Operating Model Development

* Design and implement sustainable operating models supporting global and regional data domains.
* Define roles, responsibilities, decision rights, escalation paths, and governance forums.
* Build effective collaboration models between:
  + Business teams
  + Application owners
  + Product teams
  + Enterprise Architecture
  + Operations teams
  + Data and analytics functions
* Establish service delivery models that enable consistent execution across multiple geographies and applications.
* Drive adoption of standardized data management processes for, metadata, data quality, data architecture, taxonomy, and data quality remediation.

**.**
-----

3. Master Data & Reference Data Management

* Lead enterprise master data governance programs across key domains such as Customer, Vendor, Products, and People.
* Define authoritative sources, golden record strategies, hierarchy management approaches, and lifecycle management approaches.
* Establish data management practices for reference data and shared enterprise dimensions.
* Partner with business and technology leaders to modernize master data capabilities and improve operational efficiency.

4. Metadata, Taxonomy & Data Modeling

* Establish enterprise metadata management capabilities including technical, operational, and AI metadata.
* Enable the integration of business glossaries and semantic frameworks across applications and data products.
* Lead development of conceptual, logical, and physical data modeling standards.
* Ensure enterprise data structures support interoperability, analytics, AI, and future platform modernization initiatives.

5. Data Quality & Measurement

* Lead enterprise data quality management capabilities including strategy, frameworks, procedures, monitoring, and remediation
* Operationalize quality dimensions, monitoring capabilities, issue management processes, and continuous improvement practices.
* Partner with business
